services.purpose: Bootstraps the private authenticated NVR dashboard without cameras, recordings, devices or external telemetry.

configFiles.content:
version: 0.18-0
mqtt:
  enabled: false
cameras: {}
auth:
  enabled: true
tls:
  enabled: false
networking:
  listen:
    internal: 127.0.0.1:5000
    external: 8971
telemetry:
  version_check: false
  stats:
    amd_gpu_stats: false
    intel_gpu_stats: false
    network_bandwidth: false

acceptance.description: Read only the exact current-start first-user password, rotate once to the saved private password, then prove a fresh admin login and profile.
Verify anonymous profile access is denied on authenticated 8971; never publish or use internal unauthenticated 5000.
Pending: replace the read-only bootstrap configuration through a separately approved writable owner-camera boundary; no camera or detector acceptance is claimed.
Restart only the exact owned service and verify the saved administrator still authenticates; camera persistence remains pending.
